title: Indigenous Languages and Cultures
description: Introduces the diverse perspectives on Indigenous languages and cultures. Explores the links between languages and cultures and the issues of language shift, language ideologies, and historical trends. Examines the language policies and language revitalization practices that are implemented in various parts of the world. Seeks to understand how sustainability of these languages can be achieved.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ANTH370, ANTH396 (if taken in the same topic).
